bulgarian-split-squat.criteria: Rear foot elevated on bench, front foot fixed, bend front knee and lower hips then rise. Dumbbells at sides; one side shown.

one-arm-dumbbell-row.criteria: One-arm neutral-grip row with opposite hand supported on bench; both feet remain on floor in this variation. Stable bent torso, pull toward hip and lower. One side shown.

cable-fly.criteria: Standing bilateral cable fly at chest height, slight fixed elbow bend, hands come together in front of chest and open under control.
